items.statement: The investigation validates minima by frequency analysis and transition states by one imaginary mode plus connectivity evidence, and reports conformer/scan coverage for intramolecular closures.
items.expected: Each reported stationary point has explicit frequency/minimum or first-order-saddle evidence; each reported TS has endpoint/IRC/equivalent connectivity evidence; closure claims include scan/coverage context.

items.statement: The published key barriers are TS-1 25.3, TSa-2b 14.3, TSa-2c 21.0, TS-4a 15.9 and TS-4b 20.7 kcal mol−1.
items.expected: The submitted profile reports these named barriers with correct identities and units, allowing method-dependent deviations to be discussed.

items.statement: The first intramolecular capture from cal-2b is barrierless on the reported surface and gives cal-3a/cal-3b branches; the later cal-4b to cal-5 closure is likewise reported barrierless.
items.expected: The report distinguishes barrierless closures from transition-state-mediated steps and retains branch identities.
